title: Bond should be a possible VLAN parent interface
line: When creating a VLAN connection, bonds, bridges and teams can now be picked as the parent interface.
explanation: The VLAN editor fills its "Parent interface" drop-down from the saved connections, but only kept wired ones, so bond, bridge and team connections never appeared even though NetworkManager accepts them as VLAN parents. Users had to type the interface name by hand. The list now also includes bond, bridge and team connections (still skipping connections that are ports of another one).

commits.message:
editor/vlan: offer bonds, bridges and teams as parent connections

The parent drop-down of a VLAN connection only listed wired connections,
so a VLAN on top of a bond, bridge or team could only be set up by typing
the interface name. List those connection types as parents as well.

BUG: 470149

media.caption: New VLAN connection: with bond0 and br0 configured, the parent list only offers the wired connection
Same setup with the fix: bond0 and br0 are offered too; the bond's port connection is still left out
